$description: Appearance-invariant base tokens for the default NSH Gallery UI theme.

radius.$description: Corner radius roles by layer (8px control, 12px container, 14px modal) referenced by semantic shape roles.

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

mono.$description: Monospace font family for code blocks and numeric readouts.

color.$description: Appearance-invariant C-layer color roles shared by light and dark modes.

brand-fill.$description: Accent fill color for selected calendar days and branded highlights.

on-brand.$description: Foreground text and icons on brand-fill surfaces.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets.

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

chart-foreground.$description: Dark ink on light chart tiles; dark tiles use on-media.

window-close.$description: macOS window close traffic-light button fill.

window-minimize.$description: macOS window minimize traffic-light button fill.

window-zoom.$description: macOS window zoom traffic-light button fill.

window-control-ink.$description: Glyph ink inside macOS window traffic-light buttons.

window-control-edge.$description: Hairline border around macOS window traffic-light buttons.

designMd.overview: NSH Gallery UI default theme: graphite dark and paper light surfaces with citrus lime (`#c6ef6a`) brand fill, continuous squircle corners, spring motion physics, and layered surface finishes.
designMd.elevation: Tactile layered elevation: inner top-edge highlights (`inset`), 1px hairline borders, contact + cast drop shadows (`card`, `menu`, `dialog`, `inverse`), and translucent frosted glass (`glass` with 80% popover alpha).
dos: Preserve the citrus accent (`brand-fill` / `primary`) for primary actions, active runs, and focus highlights.
Use `inset` wells inside cards and `raised` surfaces for controls sitting on cards, paired with continuous squircle corners (`shape.curve: "continuous"`).
donts: Do not flatten shadows or remove inner highlights on `card`, `raised`, `inset`, or `pill` finishes.
Do not merge distinct semantic finishes (`light` vs `accent`, `thumb` vs `raised`, `knob` vs `handle`).
